name: claude-design
description: The Scriptorium: Constellation, Marginalia, Vivarium. A local VS Code sidecar for design work using the Claude CLI.

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --outfile dist/extension.js --target node --external vscode
scripts.dev: bun --hot build src/extension.ts --outfile dist/extension.js --target node --external vscode

commands.title: Claude Design: Sign in with Claude
Claude Design: Toggle Hand (terse / discursive / diagrammatic)

claudeDesign.cliPath.description: Path to the claude CLI binary. The CLI handles OAuth and quota; Design never sees credentials directly.

claudeDesign.posture.description: Visual posture. scriptorium = parchment + marginalia + rubrics. plain = unstyled chrome.

claudeDesign.accent.description: Override the brand accent. Empty = inherit --vscode-charts-orange from the active theme.

claudeDesign.telemetry.description: Telemetry is off by default and stays that way unless you flip this on.

claudeDesign.substrate.enabled.description: Patch VS Code Insiders' workbench files once to enable the local Mica substrate. This intentionally triggers VS Code's modified installation warning.

claudeDesign.substrateCssPath.description: Absolute path to vibrancy-obsidian.css. Empty = workspace designs/vibrancy-obsidian.css.
